newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-VAAS REDUCES ZIMBABWE TO 21 FOR TWO.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-VAAS REDUCES ZIMBABWE TO 21 FOR TWO.

text.p: Left-arm paceman Chaminda Vaas took two quick wickets on Thursday to reduce Zimbabwe to 21 for two at lunch on the second day of the first test against Zimbabwe.
Earlier Sri Lanka extended their overnight score of 290 for seven to 349 all out with Kumara Dharmasena unbeaten on 42 scored in 99 minutes with four boundaries.
Vaas struck with his first ball of the innings, forcing Grant Flower to edge a sharply rising delivery to wicketkeeper Romesh Kaluwitharana.
Three overs later Vaas dismissed Alistair Campbell for 12 when the Zimbabwe captain tried to steer the ball through the slips.
After Sri Lanka resumed their first innings Dharmasena and Vaas carried their eighth-wicket partnership to 74 before leg-spinner Paul Strang broke through.
Strang bowled Vaas for 34 when the batsman got an inside edge attempting a drive.
He then cleaned up the tail with a spell of three wickets in four balls for no runs to finish with five for 106 from 34.3 overs, his first five wicket haul in eight tests.
